description: Structured data display. Supports selection, actions, pagination, and linked data.

sizing.titleBlockToTableGap: 32px (sp-8) — spec-required gap between title+description and top of table

columnHeader.background: primary-background (White #FFFFFF) — same as odd rows; header is distinguished by bold weight ONLY, not a different background color
columnHeader.note: Do not give the header a different background color — bold weight is the only visual distinction

rowHeight.overflow: Always wrap; never truncate cell content — row height grows to fit all content

zebraStriping.purpose: Improves row readability across wide tables

rules.headerBackground: Header background is WHITE, not a different color. Use bold font-weight to distinguish headers.
rules.linkColor: lab-blue for ALL linked values in data cells — never mix link and non-link text in the same column

columnContentTypes.description: Each column must use one consistent content type across all rows.

rules: Use colored pill badges in the Status column — never plain text or generic buttons
Status badge column must always be the rightmost column
Never use status badge styling in any column other than Status
Do not mix plain text and linked text within the same column
Do not use lab-blue for plain text — only for actual hyperlinks

variants.name: selectable
variants.description: Checkboxes on the left of each row for multi-row selection. Status/action button on the right.

do: Checkbox in column header for select-all
dont: Do not place checkboxes anywhere other than leftmost column

do: Column headers must label each column

variants.name: data-table-with-links
variants.description: Dense data table with linked cell values using lab-blue token.

do: lab-blue for all linked values in data cells
dont: Do not use dark-sky or any other color for links — must be lab-blue

tableHeader.description: Title and description block above the table.

spacing.gapBelowHeader: 32px (sp-8) between title+description block and top of table

do: Always include table title and description
Maintain 32px gap between header block and table
dont: Do not render a table without a title and description

do: Right-align pagination controls below the table
dont: Do not show pagination when all data fits on one page

do: Wrap cell content — row height must expand
Apply zebra striping (White odd, Salt even)
Header background = White, distinguished by bold weight only
Status badges in rightmost Status column using correct system color token
lab-blue for all linked cell text
dont: Do not give the header a different background color from odd rows
Do not render all rows the same background — zebra striping required
Do not use plain text in place of a status badge in the Status column
Do not mix linked and plain text in the same column
